description: Truck payload missing
treatment: Excluded from modelling, kept in register

description: Dump timestamp missing or unparseable
treatment: Excluded from modelling, kept in register

description: Cu, Au or Ag missing
treatment: Excluded from modelling, kept in register

description: Density missing
treatment: Excluded from modelling, kept in register

description: Dump X or Y missing
treatment: Excluded from modelling, kept in register

description: Cycle ID repeated with identical content
treatment: First copy modelled, repeats excluded

description: Cycle ID repeated with different content
treatment: First copy modelled, others excluded; resolve with an fms_exclude intervention

description: Payload <= 0 t
treatment: Excluded from modelling

description: Payload <= 50% of the median (part load)
treatment: Modelled; payload error in Monte Carlo

description: Payload > 150% of the median
treatment: Modelled; bounds the payload factor (A-06)

description: Payload not a multiple of the 38 t pass quantum (A-10)
treatment: Modelled; checked manually

description: Cu <= 0 or > 100 %, or Au/Ag < 0
treatment: Excluded from modelling

description: Grade outside Q1 - 3 IQR .. Q3 + 3 IQR
treatment: Modelled (source-block grade); flagged

description: Density outside 1.5-3.0 t/m3
treatment: Excluded from modelling

description: Dump X/Y more than 100 m outside every survey solid
treatment: Location treated as unknown (as LOC_DEFAULT)

description: X/Y/Z shared by >= 3 records (default / stuck FMS position, A-32)
treatment: Location treated as unknown: uniform push cost over the interval's fill

description: Dump X/Y outside the union of all survey change solids
treatment: Modelled: pushed from the dump point (crest dumping)

description: Dump Z outside the interval's [start surface, end surface] envelope +/- 5 m
treatment: Modelled; dump Z is not used by the engine (X/Y only)

description: Dump before the start of the first survey interval
treatment: Excluded (belongs to the pre-record pile)

description: Dump after the last survey cut-off
treatment: Placed provisionally by the forward model; reconciled when the next survey arrives

description: Timestamp identical to another record
treatment: Modelled; both kept

description: Cycle ID not in chronological order
treatment: None - the timestamp governs ordering

description: Dump inside a survey interval longer than 36 h
treatment: Modelled; the interval's spatial resolution in time is coarser
